goals.name: 调整当前页面或应用窗口的缩放
behavior: Ordinary Zoom In uses wt(1), Zoom Out wt(-1), Actual Size Tt(). Non-Mac Rt adds hidden Ctrl+= with wt(1). wt/Tt first call Ve step-zoom/reset-zoom; only when Ve is falsy do they await M and send step-window-zoom/reset-window-zoom.

Numeric-key generator options call Ve directly with +1/-1/reset and discard its result. They have no window fallback. F filters numeric accelerators; I emits hidden items. These are branch variants of the same three zoom operations, not seven features.

Selected cVs registers xs step-window-zoom/reset-window-zoom before its hidden/document render return. Step passes received delta to injected onStepZoom, reset calls injected onResetZoom, then both request banner display. A thrown provider prevents the following display request.

cVs displays Math.round(windowZoom*100), disables its Reset button only at windowZoom===1, renders a document.body portal and clears both timers on effect cleanup. Auto-hide uses supplied module constant pVs and pointer-hover ref; exit hides after150ms. Actual zoom values, increments/clamps and persistence belong to injected providers.
conditions: Platform/key filter; browser manager handling; valid focused/fallback window; mounted cVs, injected callbacks/windowZoom and document.
failureAndCancellation: A thrown Ve rejects wt/Tt before fallback; no target window means no send. Numeric aliases cannot fall back. Provider errors, native zoom and actual rendering remain unobserved.
knownGaps: Native page zoom implementation; effective onStepZoom/onResetZoom and windowZoom source/range/persistence; cVs mount, pVs/lVs initialization and actual focus/OS shortcut behavior.
